t_power.instructions: Determine the requested change for Power (t_power) using query. Apply the command-selection rules in state. Available capabilities are not requests. Return omit if this key is not requested or required by the protocol. Main appliance power only; not the switch for an individual feature.

criteria.omit: The user requests no change to the air conditioner's main power.
criteria.0: The user requests switching the air conditioner's main power off.
criteria.1: The user requests switching the air conditioner's main power on.

t_work_mode.instructions: Determine the requested change for Mode (t_work_mode) using query. Apply the command-selection rules in state. Available capabilities are not requests. Return omit if this key is not requested or required by the protocol. Main operating mode. Auto mode is different from Comfort Auto.

criteria.omit: The user does not request a change to the main operating mode.
criteria.0: The user requests Fan or fan-only as the main operating mode.
criteria.1: The user requests Heat or heating as the main operating mode.
criteria.2: The user requests Cool or cooling as the main operating mode.
criteria.3: The user requests Dry or dehumidification as the main operating mode.
criteria.4: The user requests Auto as the main operating mode, rather than the separate Comfort Auto feature.

criteria.omit: The user requests no change to Temperature (Celsius).

t_temp_type.instructions: Choose the required temperature unit. A Celsius setpoint requires value 0; a Fahrenheit setpoint requires value 1, even when no separate unit-change command is spoken. Otherwise follow an explicitly requested unit change. Choose omit only if no setpoint and no unit change is requested.

criteria.omit: Neither a Celsius or Fahrenheit setpoint nor a temperature-unit change is requested.
criteria.0: A Celsius setpoint is requested, or the user explicitly requests Celsius as the unit.
criteria.1: A Fahrenheit setpoint is requested, or the user explicitly requests Fahrenheit as the unit.
